summary: Frontend-only Maven Kitchen restaurant website tested. All major features work correctly. Site loads without console errors, all sections render properly.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='mobile-nav' not found via Playwright selector, though the drawer IS visually open (confirmed via screenshot). Either the testid is on an inner element or the nav animates in a way that hides it from is_visible check. Functional behavior works.

action_items: Optional: verify data-testid='mobile-nav' is on the visible drawer element, not a hidden wrapper — currently screenshot confirms nav opens but Playwright is_visible returns false
